newsitem.title: MEXICO: Four dead in Mexico plane crash.
newsitem.headline: Four dead in Mexico plane crash.

text.p: Three Americans and a Briton on board a small private plane died after crashing in the central Mexican state of Zacatecas, U.S. embassy officials said on Thursday.
The plane crashed into a mountain in stormy weather on Tuesday night, Monterrey consulate officer Steve Holgate told Reuters.
The small plane left from El Paso, Texas, and was en route to Toluca in the state of Mexico. Mexico's communications and transport ministry identified the plane as an Aerocommander 1121 B.

Families of the victims have been advised of the crash, Holgate said. Complete identifications of the victims and information on the cause of the crash were not immediately available, embassy officials said.
